tool.name: ShigaPass typing
tool.description: Shigella / EIEC species and serotype from assemblies
tool.command: #import re @CLI@ shigapass --assembly #for $a in $assemblies '$a' #end for --name #for $a in $assemblies '${re.sub(r"[^ \w\-.]", "_", str($a.element_identifier))}' #end for --threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-2} #set $raw = [o for o in str($raw_outputs).split(',') if o and o != 'None'] #if $mykrobe.run == 'yes' --with-mykrobe --reads-samplesheet '$reads_sheet' #if $mykrobe.reads.type == 'ont' --ont #end if #set $raw = $raw + [o for o in str($mykrobe.mykrobe_raw_outputs).split(',') if o and o != 'None'] @PANELS@ #end if #if $raw --raw-outputs ${' '.join($raw)} #end if --outdir out

configfiles.configfile: #import re #if $mykrobe.run == 'yes' sample r1 r2 #for $key in $mykrobe.reads.input.keys() #set $name = re.sub(r"[^ \w\-.]", "_", str($key)) #if $mykrobe.reads.type == 'paired' ${name} ${mykrobe.reads.input[$key].forward} ${mykrobe.reads.input[$key].reverse} #else ${name} ${mykrobe.reads.input[$key]} #end if #end for #end if

param.name: assemblies
param.label: Assemblies
param.help: One or more assemblies, or a collection. Sample names are the dataset / collection element names.

param.name: run
param.label: Also run Mykrobe genotyping (needs reads)
param.help: Adds Mykrobe genotyping and QRDR calls on the reads and writes the combined report, the same as running Mykrobe Shigella genotyping and Combine Shigella report.

param.name: mykrobe_raw_outputs
param.label: Also output Mykrobe's own files
param.option: Mykrobe JSON (one per sample and scheme)

collection.name: json
collection.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: Mykrobe JSON
collection.filter: mykrobe['run'] == 'yes' and mykrobe['mykrobe_raw_outputs'] and 'json' in mykrobe['mykrobe_raw_outputs']

data.name: predictresults
data.label: ${tool.name} on ${on_string}: mykrobeshig predictResults
data.filter: mykrobe['run'] == 'yes' and mykrobe['mykrobe_raw_outputs'] and 'predictresults' in mykrobe['mykrobe_raw_outputs']

has_line_matching.expression: ^ERR5976293\.fasta\.gz\t.*\tSS\t.*\tflexneri\t.*\tDiscordant: ShigaPass S\. sonnei, Mykrobe S\. flexneri - check\t.*
